The configuration of diagnostics on the AUTOSAR adaptive platform will typically be done by creating a Diagnostic Extract ( DEXT) as per [12, Diagnostic Extract T emplate] that is also used on the AUTOSAR classic platform . Therefore, concepts within the Diagnostic Extract are similarly applicable to models on both platforms uniformly: It can even be safely expected that a given DEXT can be divided into parts applying to CP ECU-Instance s and parts applying to AP Machine s that all belong to the same vehicle.
